title: DiGESTnewborn Study
official: Glucose Control and Metabolic Adaptation in Offspring of Women With Gestational Diabetes Recruited to the DiGest Study
summary: We wish to study the effect of a mothers sugar (glucose) control during pregnancy on her baby's sugar control after birth.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mothers and their babies who have been enrolled in DiGest Trial and who have provided informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
sponsor: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
